name: foundry-app
description: Foundry desktop — read a scanned PDF, cast a clean EPUB.

scripts.build:renderer: npm run test:templates && ng build && npm run test:surface
scripts.build: npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:electron && node tools/free-port.cjs 4260 && concurrently -k -n ng,electron "ng serve --port 4260" "wait-on http-get://localhost:4260 && electron . --dev"
scripts.package:win-x64: npm run build:engine:win-x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:engine:mac && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.package:mac:signed: npm run build:engine:mac && npm run build && node tools/package-mac.cjs

_crucibleClientNote: Crucible SDKs are vendored as immutable npm-pack tarballs: the LIBRARY this app is built against, never the release an install puts on a machine — that is the release channel's answer, read at install time (crucible docs/INSTALL-UNINSTALL.md 6.5). Compatibility with a server is the API version on X-Crucible-Api, not this number. Update both packages, integrity hashes, and generated module metadata together; directory dependencies are not supported.
